task_1_ch0_vs_ch2.label: CLAUDE_OBSERVATION -- answered from code, not guessed

branch_logic.CH2: completer.kind=='Z2' and r1.macro_index < completer.macro_index (R1 strictly BEFORE completer)
branch_logic.OTHER_OR_UNDECIDED: everything else, including a completer that fires BEFORE R1 regardless of its kind

task_1_ch0_vs_ch2.answer_part_a: CH0 (hub complete before R1) is NOT a CH2 subtype -- settled by direct code inspection: CH2's own condition requires r1.macro_index < completer.macro_index, which is false by construction whenever the completer precedes R1. This is not hypothetical: the one observed CH0-pattern instance (R1 event 4, completer at macro_index 4, R1 at macro_index 5) is recorded with branch='OTHER_OR_UNDECIDED' in the actual data, not 'CH2'.
task_1_ch0_vs_ch2.answer_part_b: whether CH0 deserves its OWN dedicated label (a true third class) versus staying folded into the generic OTHER_OR_UNDECIDED catch-all is an engineering/taxonomy choice not yet made in this codebase -- OTHER_OR_UNDECIDED also catches any other completer pattern that matches neither CH1 nor CH2 (e.g. a non-R, non-Z2 completer kind), so it is not synonymous with CH0 even though the one observed instance happens to be the CH0 pattern.
task_1_ch0_vs_ch2.provisional_ch0_counter_note: provisional_CH0_events:1 in the medium-run stats is a separate, ad-hoc diagnostic counter computed outside Decoration.branch entirely -- branch_transitions in the same stats only ever records 'UNDECIDED->CH1' and 'UNDECIDED->OTHER_OR_UNDECIDED', never a CH0-named transition

scope_flag_not_a_claimed_bug.label: CLAUDE_OBSERVATION
scope_flag_not_a_claimed_bug.statement: area_a:O_exceeded fired 40428 times via an UNCONDITIONAL call to macro.area_a_prune_reason (evaluate_edge, ~line 422 of search_rr_target_a_exhaustive.py), with no Q1/Q2 mode split. This repository's own Round 36 audit (PRUNE_CLASSIFICATION, src/search_rr_target_a_unified.py) classifies O_exceeded as Q2-ONLY (completion-assuming: 'nothing -- TARGET_O=25 is a full-completion target'), because O>25 only rules out later reaching full Area-A completion, not whether a Target A boundary (a local condition) is still reachable. search_rr_target_a_exhaustive.py is the OLDER Round 35 file (module docstring: 'deliberately a root-local Target-A boundary search... not a Target-B or NR6 completion search') and it does not implement the Q1/Q2 split that a sibling file (search_rr_target_a_unified.py) already has.
scope_flag_not_a_claimed_bug.consequence: if any of the 40428 O_exceeded-discarded states (or descendants) could reach a genuine Target A boundary that simply would not go on to full Area-A completion, this run's traversal would never find it, and its INCOMPLETE/0-hits status would not reflect that
scope_flag_not_a_claimed_bug.not_asserted: this is not claimed to be a bug -- it may be that this engine's intended scope for Codex really is the Q2 question (matching its historical Round 35 role) and the docstring's 'not a completion search' line refers to Target B/C rather than Q1/Q2 coverage. That is Codex's design decision to state, not this analyst's to assume.
scope_flag_not_a_claimed_bug.action_taken: flagged only; no file edited, no prune proposed, no search run
